meta.name: delivery-readiness-audit
meta.description: Spot-check AC internal consistency and scan for pending revisions on delivery-ready stories. Activated by `/gaai-status --audit` as Section 5. Complements the standard status checks with depth checks that standard status skips for speed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查用户故事的一致性和待修订项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需确保用户故事前后一致且无待议项
copy.tagline_en: Check user story consistency and pending revisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to ensure user stories are consistent and have no pending items

howto.what: 当你使用 /gaai-status --audit 命令时，Claude 会对标记为“准备交付”的用户故事进行两项深度审核：检查验收条件内部一致性（如引用的资源是否已声明），并扫描积压备注中的待完成修订；最后输出包含问题列表和交付裁决的报告。
howto.when: 当你输入 /gaai-status --audit 命令时触发，并在标准状态检查（第1-4节）完成后自动执行。

say.text: 运行 /gaai-status --audit 进行交付就绪审计。
say.note: Claude 将执行两项深度检查并输出报告。

say.text: 检查当前就绪故事的一致性。
say.note: 触发 AC 内部一致性检查和待处理修订扫描。

say.text: 审计交付准备度，列出问题。
say.note: 生成交付裁决，指出严重问题。

howto.what_en: When you use the /gaai-status --audit command, Claude performs two deep checks on delivery-ready stories: AC internal consistency (e.g., referenced resources are declared) and pending revisions scan. It then outputs a report with issue lists and a delivery verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the /gaai-status --audit command, running after standard status checks (Sections 1-4).

say_en.note: Claude will perform deep checks and output a report.

say_en.text: Check AC consistency for ready stories.
say_en.note: Triggers internal consistency and pending revision scan.

say_en.text: Audit delivery readiness and list issues.
say_en.note: Generates a delivery verdict with critical issues.
